ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts being made to prevent it
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How effective are the state's efforts to prevent Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on a critical issue affecting the state's most vulnerable populations. By following the money and examining the systems in place to prevent fraud, we can gain a deeper understanding of the problem and identify potential solutions.
